units.function: CLI config test for adding, normalizing and de-duplicating an allowed hostname.
units.dependencyDirection: Calls the production CLI config mutation helper against a temporary JSON file; it does not invoke server Host-header middleware.
units.keyDataModels: server.allowedHostnames string array and a URL-shaped versus bare hostname input.
units.lifecycle: Writes a base config, adds the same host twice in two forms and inspects the persisted normalized array.
units.testAssessment: Focused Vitest passed 1/1. It proves lowercase/scheme/port normalization and duplicate suppression only; runtime enforcement and adversarial hostname forms, atomic updates, permissions, symlinks and cleanup are absent.
units.designRationale: Make self-hosted exposure configuration easier and prevent duplicate hostname entries.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS self-hosted deployments need explicit trusted-origin/host policy and safe config mutation across reverse proxies and local enterprise networks.
units.companyOsFit: REFERENCE ONLY. Specify host/origin/proxy trust centrally and test the real middleware with exact canonicalization, IDN/IP/trailing-dot/wildcard rejection, forwarded-host policy, DNS-rebinding cases and atomic config writes.
units.responsibilityConflict: No direct responsibility-model conflict, but a weak ingress-host test can undermine the authenticated human and Agent boundary before responsibility checks execute.
evidence: 2026-08-18 focused Vitest: 1 passed via existing local binary
